news.title: Gorillas at Ramat Gan Safari form 'living ladder' to reach food, TAU study finds
news.summary: The study describes a “rare example of spontaneous cooperation between adult gorillas,” with each animal assuming a distinct role in reaching the branches.

news.title: Police recover antique Torah scroll case stolen from Jerusalem synagogue over 20 years ago
news.summary: Police examining the case discovered an inscription with the names of its donors, which then led to an investigation into its origins and rightful ownership.

news.title: Nearly a decade after Hapoel Tel Aviv collapse, former owner Kabiri agrees to NIS 3m settlement
news.summary: Judge calls agreement “appropriate and balanced”; settlement includes no admission of the allegations against the former club owner.

news.title: Security cabinet meets after six-week hiatus amid fears of West Bank escalation
news.summary: Israel's security cabinet met for three hours as the IDF prepared for a possible confrontation with Palestinian Authority security personnel.

news.title: Golan rules out unity government with Netanyahu, warns of new Iran war by caretaker government
news.summary: The Democrats chairman said the opposition must form a government quickly, warning that “history will judge us” if it fails to prevent another war.
